_comment: This repository writes its own prose in STE. Delete this file to opt out.
The glossary holds the words this project uses that the STE dictionary does
not, per rules 1.6 and 1.8. A word here is one we decided on, not one we
could not be bothered to fix.
_glossary_note: 'request' is here for 'pull request', which is a technical noun in this
field. The standard replaces the plain verb 'request' with TELL or WRITE.
_locale_note: Empty, so there is no spelling check. This repository writes American
English, which is what ASD-STE100 rule 1.14 asks for.
To write another variety, run: localize.py --en-GB
